name: Cradle
author: Erin Carter
description: A cat's-cradle of taut glowing chords strung corner-to-corner across the dark. Each straight string is a thin bright core with a soft halo, palette-tinted along its length, with glint beads sliding down it; where strings cross, the intersection brightens. On staggered schedules the anchors glide to new perimeter positions, so the figure forever re-strings itself one chord at a time.

params.label: Morph speed
params.effect: Cadence and glide rate of anchors trading places — low is a meditative slow re-stringing, high keeps several chords visibly swinging to new positions at once.

params.label: Chords
params.effect: Number of strung lines — low is a stark minimal figure, high is a dense layered string-art web with many crossings.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each chord in CSS px, with halo scaling alongside — thin reads as hairline wire, thick as soft neon string.

params.label: Glint speed
params.effect: Travel speed of the bright beads sliding along the chords — at 0 they rest as fixed highlights, at max light visibly courses down every string.
